svg.title: Where pstack's /correct skill puts a fix for a repeated agent mistake
svg.desc: Five levels, tried from the top: eliminate it with architecture, enforce it with types, a lint or CI check whose error names the fix, a test of the behavior, and docs or agent rules last, only for judgment calls. The top levels make the mistake impossible; the bottom one fails silently when an agent skips it.

text.font-family: Work Sans, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A correction belongs in the repo, not in a rules file

text.font-family: Work Sans, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pstack's /correct: fix each repeated mistake at the highest level that works. A class counts once it has happened twice.
